timeline.title: Baseline hypertension and renal risk assessment.
Lisinopril discontinued in the prescribing plan and losartan ordered.
Diarrheal illness with poor intake and emergency hydration.
Old lisinopril bottle and uncertain reported use conflict with current clinic list.
Nephrology reviews partial renal recovery and multiple possible contributors.
Renal values remain improved but above baseline; exposure history remains uncertain.
